questions.question: What does (1 << 31) evaluate to in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: Bitwise operators work on 32-bit signed integers; bit 31 is the sign bit. Use >>> 0 to read the result as unsigned.

questions.question: What does x & (x - 1) do?
options: Isolates the lowest set bit of x
Clears the lowest set bit of x
questions.explanation: Subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit and the zeros below it, so ANDing clears that bit. It powers Kernighan's popcount and the power-of-two check.

questions.question: Every element appears twice except one. Which approach finds it in O(n) time and O(1) extra space?
options: Sort the array and scan neighbours
Count occurrences in a hash map
Sum the elements and divide by 2
questions.explanation: a ^ a = 0 and XOR is commutative, so all pairs cancel and only the single element remains. Sorting is O(n log n) and a hash map uses O(n) space.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of the bitmask DP for travelling salesman over n cities?
questions.explanation: There are 2^n * n states (mask, last city) and each tries up to n next cities — far smaller than n! for n near 20.
